Today's discovery started innocously; I stepped out to get some much-needed air and ended my jog by stopping into a small corner bookstore, a familiar and comforting presence near where work. The owner was there today as she is on most after work weekdays - the sort whose smile can light any room just because of her easy and warm personality - I was greeted and she inquired of what brought a smile that was as warm. 

As the bell chimedd, I noticed the latest batch on a table in the display case: an assortment from a new publishing line of practical and concise productivity manuals and guides, ones with straightforward advice that felt as refreshing to me then like a breath during the summer when it seems every leaf wants the shade of every nearby branch for relief from that oppressive, relentless heat - but I needed none, only this new addition. The books
